summary: The wrapper adds one constant-time state check to each call, matching the constant lower bound and leaving no genuine slower principal class for scaling.

optimality.argument: Every wrapper invocation must decide whether it may forward, requiring Omega(1) work. Reading and possibly setting one Boolean uses O(1) overhead, excluding the wrapped function's own runtime.

replacement_checks.evidence: Every invocation must inspect enough state to decide whether the underlying function may run.
The wrapper reads one captured Boolean, sets it once, and otherwise performs no work beyond forwarding the permitted call.
Regression covers single and repeated calls, variadic forwarding, defined zero, independent wrappers, receiver preservation, and exception behavior.
